--- pipe_union_all.sql
FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS number
|> UNION ALL (SELECT 3),

                Value:    "2",

      &ast.PipeSetOperation{
        Pipe:          30,

}

--- SQL
FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS number |> UNION ALL (SELECT 3)
